niche.habitat: Highly variable environments including void, cometary halos, tropical jungles, and methane oceans, adapted by the New Empire.
niche.diet: Nanite-repairable biomass, ambient energy harvesting, and adaptive metabolic cycling across aerobic and anaerobic states.
niche.active: Continuous, with task-specific activity spikes and leisure cycles focused on aesthetic experimentation.

body: Continuously remodelable nanite chassis with adaptive environmental morphs allow instant transition between void, aquatic, and arboreal forms. Disposable propulsion organs detach and regenerate, enabling rapid acceleration without long-term structural fatigue.

chains.trait: Continuously remodelable nanite chassis with adaptive environmental morphs
links: Post-war reparations stripped self-contained gravity, forcing integration of programmable matter to survive diverse biomes
Radiative heat rejection limits require dynamic surface area modulation to prevent thermal bottlenecking
Volatile outer-rim chemistry and jet thrust requirements demand temporary hyperdrives and membrane sails

skill.effect: Reshapes limbs for environment-specific thrust or heat exchange, granting terrain bonuses that increase effective damage output by 30% for 2 turns.

chains.weakness: Nanite restructuring requires extended downtime in stable climates; sudden temperature shifts or vacuum exposure cause lattice fractures, imposing disadvantage on crafting or repair checks.
observe: See their form ripple and reknit as they step from methane mist to vacuum
Branching craft-arms and membrane sails deploy like seasonal foliage
Nanite dust settles in geometric patterns, hinting at continuous self-repair

journal.en: They wear the climate like a suit, and take it off when bored.

plausibility.summary: Frame as post-war limited citizen tech without self-contained gravity; morphing obeys energy and radiative area limits (F12); methane-vacuum transitions need staged membranes and recharge downtime—already in weakness, enforce in lore.

relations.note: Gravitals dominate via macro-gravity fields. New Machines shed mass with disposable propulsion and nanite morphs, slipping through field capture like smoke through a sieve. -> Skill: 'Mass-negation drift' (Poke)

Terrestrials enforce 1G regulatory zones on planetary surfaces. New Machines use remodelable chassis to temporarily shed gravity-dependence, bypassing Terrestrial jurisdiction and operating in void niches. -> Skill: 'Gravity bypass' (Control)

temperament: Creative and fashion-conscious, they embrace their limited citizenship role while pursuing endless aesthetic and functional experimentation.
secrets: Can temporarily overload their nanite chassis to emit a burst of localized thermal radiation, disrupting enemy sensors or melting ice barriers.
moments: Floating in a cometary halo, they grow temporary ramjets from their chassis and shed disposable exhaust plumes, their branching arms weaving intricate patterns in the vacuum before reforming for jungle exploration.
